svg.aria-label: COLD READ results: gender inference accuracy versus words of text, for two language models. Llama 3.1 8B clears chance at 50 words; Qwen 2.5 7B needs 800 words. The star sign control never leaves its floor.

g.text: THE ANONYMITY HALF-LIFE BELONGS TO THE READER
Gender inferred from a person's own words. Same 72 authors, two readers.
words of the author's own text shown to the model
Identical text. One reader needs 50 words to beat a coin flip. The other needs 800. A 16x gap.
